description: Lightweight, modular JavaScript lightbox and gallery for images and video, with native React, Vue and Angular packages on a shared headless core.
rules: Plugins are separate entries: import them from lightgallery/plugins/<name> (or @lightgallery/<framework>/plugins/<name>) and pass them in the plugins list; their settings are ignored otherwise.
CSS is a consumer import in every stack: import lightgallery/css/lightgallery.css plus one file per plugin, or lightgallery/css/lightgallery-bundle.css.

The framework packages are @lightgallery/react, @lightgallery/vue and @lightgallery/angular (version 3); the lightgallery/react, lightgallery/vue and lightgallery/angular wrappers are the retired 2.x API.
Prefer the markdown docs: https://www.lightgalleryjs.com/llms.txt indexes every page, and each docs page has a twin at /docs/<page>/index.md.
